1.text: Bageze bugufi bw'i Yerusalemu bajya i Betifage n'i Betaniya ku musozi wa Elayono, atuma babiri mu bigishwa be

2.text: arababwira ati “Mujye mu kirorero kiri imbere yanyu, mukihagera uwo mwanya muri bubone icyana cy'indogobe kiziritse kitigeze guheka umuntu, mukiziture mukizane.

3.text: Kandi nihagira umuntu ubabaza ati ‘Ni iki gitumye mukora mutyo?’ mumubwire muti ‘Databuja ni we ugishaka.’ Nuko uwo mwanya aracyohereza hano.”

4.text: Baragenda basanga icyana cy'indogobe kiziritse ku irembo ku nzira, barakizitura.

5.text: Bamwe mu bari bahagaze aho barababaza bati “Ni iki gitumye muzitura icyana cy'indogobe?”

6.text: Nabo babasubiza nk'uko Yesu yababwiye, barabemerera.

7.text: Bashorera icyana cy'indogobe bakigeza aho Yesu ari, bagiteguraho imyenda yabo acyicaraho.

8.text: Benshi basasa imyenda yabo mu nzira, abandi baca amashami y'ibiti na yo bayasasa mu nzira.

9.text: Abamushagaye bararangurura bati “Hoziyana, hahirwe uje mu izina ry'Uwiteka,

10.text: hahirwe n'ubwami buje ari bwo bwami bwa sogokuruza Dawidi. Hoziyana ahasumba hose!”

11.text: Agera i Yerusalemu yinjira mu rusengero, amaze kuraranganya amaso ngo arebe byose arasohoka, maze kuko bwari bugorobye ajya i Betaniya, ajyana n'abo cumi na babiri.

12.text: Bukeye bwaho mu gitondo bamaze kuva i Betaniya, arasonza.

13.text: Areba kure abona umutini uriho ibibabi, arawegera ngo ahari yawubonaho imbuto. Nyamara awugezeho ntiyagira icyo abona keretse ibibabi, kuko kitāri igihe cyo kwera kw'imitini.

14.text: Arawubwira ati “Umuntu ntakarye ku mbuto zawe iteka ryose.” Abigishwa be barabyumva.

15.text: Bagera i Yerusalemu yinjira mu rusengero, yubika ameza y'abavunjaga ifeza n'intebe z'abaguraga inuma,

16.text: ntiyakundira umuntu wese kugira icyo anyuza mu rusengero.

17.text: Arigisha ati “Mbese ntimuzi ko byanditswe ngo ‘Inzu yanjye izitwa inzu yo gusengerwamo n'amahanga yose’? Ariko mwebwe mwayihinduye isenga y'abambuzi.”

18.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi babyumvise bashaka uko bamwica, ariko baramutinya kuko abantu bose batangazwaga no kwigisha kwe.

20.text: Bukeye bwaho mu gitondo kare, bakigenda babona wa mutini wumye uhereye ku mizi.

21.text: Petero yibutse ibyawo aramubwira ati “Mwigisha, dore wa mutini wavumye wumye.”

23.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko umuntu wese wabwira uyu musozi ati ‘Shinguka utabwe mu nyanja’, ntashidikanye mu mutima we, yizeye yuko icyo avuze gikorwa yakibona.

24.text: Ni cyo gitumye mbabwira nti ‘Ibyo musaba byose mubishyizeho umutima mwizere yuko mubihawe, kandi muzabibona.

25.text: Kandi nimuhagarara musenga hakaba hari umuntu wabagiriye nabi, mumubabarire kugira ngo So wo mu ijuru na we abababarire ibyaha byanyu. [

26.text: Ariko nimutababarira abandi, So wo mu ijuru na we ntazabababarira ibyaha byanyu.]’ ”

27.text: Bongera kujya i Yerusalemu. Akigendagenda mu rusengero, abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi n'abakuru baza aho ari

28.text: baramubaza bati “Ni butware ki bugutera gukora ibyo? Cyangwa ni nde waguhaye ubwo butware bwo kubikora?”

29.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Nanjye reka mbabaze ijambo rimwe munsubize, maze mbone kubabwira ubutware buntera kubikora.

30.text: Kubatiza kwa Yohana kwavuye mu ijuru, cyangwa ni mu bantu? Nimunsubize.”

31.text: Biburanya mu mitima yabo bati “Nituvuga tuti ‘Kwavuye mu ijuru’, aratubaza ati ‘Ni iki cyababujije kumwemera?’

32.text: Keretse tuvuze tuti ‘Kwavuye mu bantu.’ ” Ariko batinya abantu kuko bose bemeraga ko Yohana yari umuhanuzi nyakuri.

33.text: Basubiza Yesu bati “Ntitubizi.”Yesu arababwira ati “Nuko rero nanjye simbabwira ubutware buntera gukora ibyo ubwo ari bwo.”
